description: Any step, when no other tool fits: use this when the person asks an open question for one of Andru's domain experts. Gets a domain-scoped answer in natural language (it may call lookup tools; tools that cost money must be called directly). One turn per call; pass prior turns as `history` to continue. Use `module` to pick the expert (e.g. 'market-clarity', 'deal-acceleration', 'due-diligence', 'portfolio-ops').

history.description: Optional prior turns: [{ role, content }]. At most 10 turns of 2,000 characters each.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional: any unique string for this call. Retrying with the same key returns the first result and never charges twice.

maxAmountCents.description: Optional: the most this call may cost, in cents. If the price is higher, nothing runs and nothing is charged.

message.description: Your question / request for the agent (up to 4,000 characters).

quoteId.description: Optional: the quote_id from quote, to pay the quoted price (held for 30 minutes).

name: consult_agent
title: Ask an Andru specialist
